title: Apply canonical Period Total formula everywhere totals are reported; make voucher tips optional

requirements.text: Update all places where the app reports a "Period Total" (and any other primary total meant to represent the driver’s owed/period amount) to ALWAYS use this canonical formula: ((credit meter + voucher meter − cash meter) ÷ 2) + credit tips + voucher tips.

quotes: It should ALWAYS use that calculation in all places it is reported.

acceptanceCriteria: In the Daily Report screen, the value labeled "Period Total" is computed using ((credit meter + voucher meter − cash meter) / 2) + credit tips + voucher tips (not meter+tips).
For each day row in the Daily Report, the primary per-day total shown to the user uses the same canonical formula.
Any other UI locations that present a period/daily owed/period total use the same canonical formula (no alternative/legacy computations remain).
The example from the user’s screenshot scenario produces 731.385 (before currency rounding/formatting) when using the provided inputs.

requirements.text: Fix backend daily report aggregation so that the report fields used by the frontend for per-day totals and summary Period Total are derived from the canonical formula (not from summing per-pickup meterTotal+tip). Ensure the report still returns meter and tip breakdowns by payment method (cash/credit/voucher) as it does today.

quotes: It should ALWAYS use that calculation in all places it is reported.

acceptanceCriteria: Backend getDailyReport computes per-day totals by aggregating meter/tip by payment method, then calculates the per-day canonical total using ((credit + voucher − cash) / 2) + creditTips + voucherTips.

Backend getDailyReport computes the summary "Period Total" using the same canonical formula over the period aggregates (or equivalently by summing per-day canonical totals) and returns that value consistently.
Existing meter/tip breakdown fields (cash/credit/voucher and total meter/tips) remain available in the response for display.

requirements.text: Make voucher tips supported but optional: the app must allow voucher tips, but must not require voucher tips to be present in imported data or user entry; when absent they must default to 0 and not cause validation/import failures.

quotes: There are rarely voucher tips. But application should allow them but not require.

acceptanceCriteria: Import: if a pickup’s tip amount and/or tip payment method is missing in imported JSON, the import succeeds by defaulting missing tip amount to 0 and using a sensible default tip payment method (so voucher tips are not required).

UI entry/edit: users can select voucher as a tip payment method and enter a tip amount, but the UI does not require voucher tips specifically; saving with no voucher tips results in voucher tip totals of 0 in reports.
When voucher tips are not present, report voucher tip totals display as $0.00 (or equivalent formatting) and do not affect the canonical Period Total calculation beyond adding 0.

requirements.text: Ensure the frontend consistently labels and displays the canonical formula-based value as the main reported total ("Period Total" / per-day total) and does not accidentally substitute meter+tips totals in those locations.

quotes: It should ALWAYS use that calculation in all places it is reported.

acceptanceCriteria: Daily Report dialog: the "Period Total" number corresponds to the canonical formula result from the backend, and matches the backend value exactly (subject only to currency formatting/rounding).
Daily Report per-day cards: the primary total shown for the day uses the canonical formula result (and is not the sum of meter+tips unless that happens to match).
If the app still shows meter+tips totals anywhere, it is clearly not presented as the canonical Period Total and does not conflict with the user’s requirement.

constraints: Backend must remain a single Motoko actor (all logic in backend/main.mo).
Do not edit any files under frontend/src/components/ui or any frontend immutablePaths listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT; compose existing components instead.
Use English for all user-facing text.
nonGoals: Adding new authentication providers (only Internet Identity supported).
Adding external databases or third-party services.
